mapper.sql: c.CLASS_CODE, c.OPERATOR_CODE AS AUTHOR_CODE, c.NAME AS CLASS_TITLE, ( SELECT MIN(ci.IMAGE) KEEP (DENSE_RANK FIRST ORDER BY ci.SORT_ORDER) FROM CLASS_IMG ci WHERE ci.CLASS_CODE = c.CLASS_CODE AND ci.TYPE = '대표' ) AS THUMBNAIL_PATH, ( SELECT ct.NAME FROM CATEGORY ct WHERE ct.CATEGORY_CODE = c.CATEGORY_CODE ) AS CATEGORY_NAME, '등록 일정' AS SCHEDULE_TYPE, c.DESIRED_PRICE, c.WRITE_DATE AS REGISTERED_DATE, ( SELECT MIN(r.OPERATION_START_DATE) FROM CLASS_REPEAT_RULE r WHERE r.CLASS_CODE = c.CLASS_CODE ) AS RECRUIT_START_DATE, ( SELECT MAX(r.OPERATION_END_DATE) FROM CLASS_REPEAT_RULE r WHERE r.CLASS_CODE = c.CLASS_CODE ) AS RECRUIT_END_DATE, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SCHEDULE s JOIN CLASS_REPEAT_RULE r ON s.REPEAT_RULE_CODE = r.REPEAT_RULE_CODE WHERE r.CLASS_CODE = c.CLASS_CODE AND s.CLASS_DATE >= TRUNC(SYSDATE) ) AS UPCOMING_SCHEDULE_COUNT, ( SELECT NVL(SUM(rv.PEOPLE_NUMBER), 0) FROM RESERVATION rv WHERE rv.CLASS_CODE = c.CLASS_CODE AND rv.STATUS = '예약' ) AS APPLICANT_COUNT, c.STATUS AS CLASS_STATUS
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM CLASS c WHERE c.OPERATOR_CODE = #{authorCode} AND c.APPROVAL_STATUS = '승인'
AND c.STATUS = #{classStatus}
AND ( c.NAME LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR TO_CHAR(c.CLASS_CODE) LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' )
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM CLASS_REPEAT_RULE rf WHERE rf.CLASS_CODE = c.CLASS_CODE AND rf.OPERATION_END_DATE >= TO_DATE(#{fromDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') )
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM CLASS_REPEAT_RULE rt WHERE rt.CLASS_CODE = c.CLASS_CODE AND rt.OPERATION_START_DATE < TO_DATE(#{toDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') + 1 )
ORDER BY c.WRITE_DATE DESC, c.CLASS_CODE DESC

SELECT ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CLASS c WHERE c.OPERATOR_CODE = #{authorCode} AND c.APPROVAL_STATUS = '승인' AND c.STATUS = '모집중' ) AS OPEN_CLASS_COUNT, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CLASS c WHERE c.OPERATOR_CODE = #{authorCode} AND c.APPROVAL_STATUS = '승인' AND c.STATUS = '준비중' ) AS HIDDEN_CLASS_COUNT, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CLASS c WHERE c.OPERATOR_CODE = #{authorCode} AND c.APPROVAL_STATUS = '승인' AND c.STATUS = '폐강' ) AS CLOSED_CLASS_COUNT, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SCHEDULE s JOIN CLASS_REPEAT_RULE r ON r.REPEAT_RULE_CODE = s.REPEAT_RULE_CODE JOIN CLASS c ON c.CLASS_CODE = r.CLASS_CODE WHERE c.OPERATOR_CODE = #{authorCode} AND c.APPROVAL_STATUS = '승인' AND s.CLASS_DATE >= TRUNC(SYSDATE) AND s.CLASS_DATE < ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MM'), 1) ) AS MONTHLY_SCHEDULE_COUNT, ( SELECT NVL(SUM(rv.PEOPLE_NUMBER), 0) FROM RESERVATION rv JOIN CLASS c ON c.CLASS_CODE = rv.CLASS_CODE WHERE c.OPERATOR_CODE = #{authorCode} AND c.APPROVAL_STATUS = '승인' AND rv.STATUS = '예약' ) AS TOTAL_APPLICANT_COUNT, ( SELECT NVL(SUM(p.AMOUNT), 0) FROM PAYMENT p JOIN RESERVATION rv ON rv.RESERVATION_CODE = p.RESERVATION_CODE JOIN CLASS c ON c.CLASS_CODE = rv.CLASS_CODE WHERE c.OPERATOR_CODE = #{authorCode} AND c.APPROVAL_STATUS = '승인' AND p.STATUS = '결제완료' AND NVL(p.REFUND, 0) = 0 AND p.PAYMENT_DATE >= TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MM') AND p.PAYMENT_DATE < ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MM'), 1) ) AS MONTHLY_SALES_AMOUNT FROM DUAL

SELECT s.SCHEDULE_CODE, c.CLASS_CODE, c.NAME AS CLASS_TITLE, c.STATUS AS CLASS_STATUS, s.CLASS_DATE AS SCHEDULE_DATE, s.START_TIME, s.END_TIME, s.MIN_PEOPLE, s.MAX_PEOPLE, NVL(( SELECT SUM(rv.PEOPLE_NUMBER) FROM RESERVATION rv WHERE rv.SCHEDULE_CODE = s.SCHEDULE_CODE AND rv.STATUS = '예약' ), 0) AS RESERVED_COUNT, s.REMAINING_PEOPLE, CASE WHEN TRUNC(s.CLASS_DATE) < TRUNC(SYSDATE) THEN '진행 완료' WHEN s.SOLD_OUT_YN = 'Y' OR s.REMAINING_PEOPLE = 0 THEN '모집 마감' ELSE '모집중' END AS SCHEDULE_STATUS FROM SCHEDULE s JOIN CLASS_REPEAT_RULE r ON r.REPEAT_RULE_CODE = s.REPEAT_RULE_CODE JOIN CLASS c ON c.CLASS_CODE = r.CLASS_CODE WHERE c.OPERATOR_CODE = #{authorCode} AND c.APPROVAL_STATUS = '승인'
AND TRUNC(s.CLASS_DATE) >= TRUNC(SYSDATE) AND s.SOLD_OUT_YN != 'Y' AND s.REMAINING_PEOPLE > 0
AND TRUNC(s.CLASS_DATE) >= TRUNC(SYSDATE) AND (s.SOLD_OUT_YN = 'Y' OR s.REMAINING_PEOPLE = 0)
AND TRUNC(s.CLASS_DATE) < TRUNC(SYSDATE)
AND ( c.NAME LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR TO_CHAR(c.CLASS_CODE) LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR TO_CHAR(s.SCHEDULE_CODE) LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' )
AND s.CLASS_DATE >= TO_DATE(#{fromDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
AND s.CLASS_DATE < TO_DATE(#{toDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') + 1
ORDER BY CASE WHEN TRUNC(s.CLASS_DATE) >= TRUNC(SYSDATE) THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, CASE WHEN TRUNC(s.CLASS_DATE) >= TRUNC(SYSDATE) THEN s.CLASS_DATE END, CASE WHEN TRUNC(s.CLASS_DATE) < TRUNC(SYSDATE) THEN s.CLASS_DATE END DESC, s.START_TIME, s.SCHEDULE_CODE
mapper.update: UPDATE CLASS c SET STATUS = '폐강' WHERE c.CLASS_CODE = #{classCode} AND c.OPERATOR_CODE = #{authorCode} AND c.APPROVAL_STATUS = '승인' AND c.STATUS IN ('모집중', '준비중') AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM SCHEDULE s JOIN CLASS_REPEAT_RULE r ON r.REPEAT_RULE_CODE = s.REPEAT_RULE_CODE WHERE r.CLASS_CODE = c.CLASS_CODE AND TRUNC(s.CLASS_DATE) >= TRUNC(SYSDATE) AND (s.SOLD_OUT_YN != 'Y' OR s.REMAINING_PEOPLE > 0) ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM RESERVATION rv JOIN SCHEDULE s ON s.SCHEDULE_CODE = rv.SCHEDULE_CODE WHERE rv.CLASS_CODE = c.CLASS_CODE AND rv.STATUS = '예약' AND TRUNC(s.CLASS_DATE) >= TRUNC(SYSDATE) )
mapper.select: SELECT ma.LOCAL_PASSWORD FROM CREATOR cr JOIN MEMBER_AUTH ma ON ma.MEMBER_CODE = cr.MEMBER_CODE WHERE cr.OPERATOR_CODE = #{authorCode} AND ma.LOGIN_TYPE = 'LOCAL' AND ROWNUM = 1

SELECT NVL(SUM(p.AMOUNT), 0) FROM PAYMENT p JOIN RESERVATION rv ON rv.RESERVATION_CODE = p.RESERVATION_CODE JOIN CLASS c ON c.CLASS_CODE = rv.CLASS_CODE WHERE c.OPERATOR_CODE = #{authorCode} AND c.CLASS_CODE = #{classCode} AND c.APPROVAL_STATUS = '승인' AND p.STATUS = '결제완료' AND NVL(p.REFUND, 0) = 0
SELECT NVL(SUM(rv.PEOPLE_NUMBER), 0) FROM RESERVATION rv WHERE rv.CLASS_CODE = #{classCode} AND rv.STATUS = '예약'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM RESERVATION rv JOIN SCHEDULE s ON rv.SCHEDULE_CODE = s.SCHEDULE_CODE WHERE rv.CLASS_CODE = #{classCode} AND rv.STATUS = '예약' AND s.CLASS_DATE >= TRUNC(SYSDATE)

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SCHEDULE s JOIN CLASS_REPEAT_RULE r ON s.REPEAT_RULE_CODE = r.REPEAT_RULE_CODE WHERE r.CLASS_CODE = #{classCode} AND s.CLASS_DATE >= TRUNC(SYSDATE) AND (s.SOLD_OUT_YN != 'Y' OR s.REMAINING_PEOPLE > 0)

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CALCULATE ca JOIN PAYMENT p ON p.PAYMENT_CODE = ca.PAYMENT_CODE JOIN RESERVATION rv ON rv.RESERVATION_CODE = p.RESERVATION_CODE JOIN CLASS c ON c.CLASS_CODE = rv.CLASS_CODE WHERE c.OPERATOR_CODE = #{authorCode} AND c.APPROVAL_STATUS = '승인' AND rv.SCHEDULE_CODE = #{scheduleCode} AND rv.STATUS = '예약' AND p.STATUS = '결제완료'

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM PAYMENT p JOIN RESERVATION rv ON rv.RESERVATION_CODE = p.RESERVATION_CODE JOIN CLASS c ON c.CLASS_CODE = rv.CLASS_CODE WHERE c.OPERATOR_CODE = #{authorCode} AND c.APPROVAL_STATUS = '승인' AND c.STATUS IN ('모집중', '준비중') AND rv.SCHEDULE_CODE = #{scheduleCode} AND rv.STATUS = '예약' AND p.STATUS = '결제완료' AND NVL(p.REFUND, 0) < p.AMOUNT AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM CALCULATE ca WHERE ca.PAYMENT_CODE = p.PAYMENT_CODE )
mapper.update: UPDATE PAYMENT p SET STATUS = '환불완료', REFUND = p.AMOUNT, REFUND_DATE = SYSDATE WHERE p.STATUS = '결제완료' AND NVL(p.REFUND, 0) < p.AMOUNT AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM CALCULATE ca WHERE ca.PAYMENT_CODE = p.PAYMENT_CODE ) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM RESERVATION rv JOIN CLASS c ON c.CLASS_CODE = rv.CLASS_CODE WHERE rv.RESERVATION_CODE = p.RESERVATION_CODE AND rv.SCHEDULE_CODE = #{scheduleCode} AND rv.STATUS = '예약' AND c.OPERATOR_CODE = #{authorCode} AND c.APPROVAL_STATUS = '승인' AND c.STATUS IN ('모집중', '준비중') )

UPDATE RESERVATION rv SET STATUS = '취소' WHERE rv.SCHEDULE_CODE = #{scheduleCode} AND rv.STATUS = '예약' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM CLASS c WHERE c.CLASS_CODE = rv.CLASS_CODE AND c.OPERATOR_CODE = #{authorCode} AND c.APPROVAL_STATUS = '승인' AND c.STATUS IN ('모집중', '준비중') )
